verdict.rationale: Twilio's docs claim Authy is available on macOS, Windows, and Linux [authy-docs-16]. Multiple independent community reports concretely contradict this, saying the desktop apps were EOL'd and removed with near-immediate deprecation [authy-comm-10, authy-comm-18]. The current features page also lists only phone, tablet, and Apple Watch, with sync across mobile and tablet [authy-docs-3, authy-docs-4]. Missing for 10: a currently supported first-class desktop app, evidence of desktop vault/code access working today, and hands-on corroboration of desktop functionality.
